expected_objective: First, 2021 Year 8 Month 16 On that day, Yuxi City published the “Lake Revolution” Implementation Programme for Yuxi City, a revolution in ideological, lake-management measures and institutional mechanisms, with a focus on the “one core and two zones” of the Yuxi, with a view to protecting the economic and social development of the basins under its control, maintaining precision in the treatment of lakes, scientific management of lakes, application of the rule of law and the management of lakes for all, in an effort to make the “three lakes” basin a model area for the implementation of the “two mountains”. Second, in accordance with the Yunnan Province Fuxian Lake Protection Ordinance, and the announcement by the Office of the People ' s Government of Yuxi City that Fuxian Lake, Xingyun Lake, and Qilu Lake will be issued a programme for the division of responsibilities for the management of protection (OJY). 2018 〕 72 Under the terms of the Act, Yuxi Fuxian Lake Administration is directly responsible for the integrated administrative enforcement of protected areas at the level of the “Three Lakes” and for the organization and coordination of major investigation units, law enforcement supervision and law enforcement patrols. Third, in accordance with the circular of the Office of the Ministry of Agriculture on the publication of the Plan for the Upgrading and Maintenance of Fishery Ports (AAOFO) 2018 】 1 No. ; Ministry of Agriculture, Rules for the Implementation of the Fisheries Port Upgrading and Restoration Project (Pilot) (Agriculture and Fisheries Programme) [Agriculture and Fisheries Programme] 2017 】 46 No.; the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs is currently organizing the preparation of the National Plan for the Upgrading and Maintenance of Fishery Ports. 2021 — 2025 In the planning process for the upgrading and maintenance of fishing ports, the needs and views of local communities will be taken into account and integrated and coordinated development will be promoted. Fourth, Fuxian Lake, located in Yunnan Province, Yuxi City, has a heavy workload and mandate for the safety oversight of fishing vessels, environmental protection of fishery resources during fishing seasons, a time-barred enforcement of offices in the fishing field, and is unable to meet the requirements of fisheries law enforcement. In order to eliminate the safety oversight management of fishing vessels and maintain normal production order in fisheries, it is proposed to strengthen the maintenance of the previously damaged docks in the integrated administrative enforcement, further strengthen fisheries policy enforcement, strengthen law enforcement, effectively and in a timely manner combat all violations in fisheries waters, and improve the functioning of fisheries governance, improve the management of fishing vessels, improve administrative efficiency and reduce administrative costs, both to eliminate security hazards in the use of the former docks and to enhance the safety of docking at the First Squadron Star Point, as well as facilitate the port-to-port return of Second Brigade administrative law enforcement officers to ports and create a beautiful windline with Fuxian Lake.
actual_completion: Completion of the consolidation, repair, demolition, construction, electrical installation, lighting works, lamps, pre-burials, basic procurement and installation, procurement of pipes, fitting, installation, commissioning, debugging, testing, and so forth.
